methodology.app: Existing installed non-debuggable release; no replacement or code changes
methodology.workload: Temporary two-pane Python PTY. Twenty-three rows of colored changing text at up to 30 Hz for 10 seconds after input; four horizontal pane swipes, output restart and vertical scroll
methodology.foreground: Rexlink visible, unlocked, 1080x2340 display; observed active display mode 120 Hz
methodology.markers: Existing Rexlet.decodeUpdate and Rexlet.drawTerminal trace sections
methodology.controls: No UI hierarchy inspection inside final recording window; no app build/install during measurement
methodology.scope: Heavy repaint/navigation stress sample, not a distribution of ordinary Codex typing

render_thread_drawframe.definition: HWUI RenderThread DrawFrame slice wall duration, not GPU-only or CPU-only time

gfxinfo.definition: Independent Android gfxinfo counters; interval extends slightly beyond Perfetto bounds, therefore counts differ

trace_health.note: Informational chunk counter alone is not evidence of loss; final capture reports no error/data_loss/overrun/overwrite counters

interpretation: Decode and Canvas recording are only part of UI cost. RenderThread frame work and queued presentation also matter.
App and compositor deadline-miss flags overlap; attribution is mixed rather than exclusively Canvas or exclusively the app.
FrameTimeline reports 324 buffer-stuffed frames; late presentation is far more common than dropped frames in this stress test.
Next optimization target is RenderThread command cost and update/frame pacing, followed by an equivalent before/after trace.
limitations: No exact native-publication-to-pixel or key-to-pixel latency: current markers do not correlate native revisions to presented display frames.
Decode and draw percentiles are separate populations and must not be added together.
FrameTimeline app duration starts at Choreographer callback and ends at max(GPU completion, buffer post); it is not directly the extra delay added to network echo.
Do not generalize stress-test deadline-miss percentage to ordinary typing.
Earlier broader captures had smaller buffers; final trace is the reported source of metrics.
